**Result: nothing needs to be sent.**

The report shows VLSFO consumption of 28.3 t and speed of 9.5 kn, against a CP warranty of 24 t/day and 12.5 kn. The checker flagged the day (+17.9% fuel, speed below the allowed tolerance).

The day is therefore **excluded from the speed and fuel warranty**.

A voyage note has been filed recording this. Since the heavy weather accounts for the excess fuel and lost speed, no message to the Master or operator is required at this stage.
